sections.heading: Kareena Kapoor — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Kareena Kapoor was born on 21 September 1980 in Mumbai, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name her father, Randhir Kapoor and her mother, Babita Kapoor. She is a sibling of Karishma Kapoor.
She studied at Mithibai College, Jamnabai Narsee School, Welham Girls' School and Government Law College, Mumbai, India.
She is recorded as speaking Hindi and English.
